notes.title: Update #4 [Major Fixes & Changes]
notes.content:
Change log - Update #4
----
Brightned Pain Island Map
-
Moved a few stubborn platforms
Removed a few stubborn platforms
Added 2 additional Jump pads
Added addition Planks
Removed burning building
-
Lowered turret shoot speed to 2 seconds
-
Player movement:

Braking friction .2 to .4
Ground friction from 8 to 6
Braking deceleration falling 1 to 2
Falling lateral friction 1.5 to 1.7
Jump z velocity 750 to 760

(Basically better air control and more grip)
-
Added pause button on controller
-
Added lioness sfx
-
Game instructions more noticeable at game start

notes.title: Enhancements and Fixes
notes.content:
Input Adjustment: Changed climbing input from 'W' to 'Space' for better accessibility.
Audio Enhancement: Fixed rapid replay of Jump audio.
Precision Landing: Improved precision in player landings.
Achievement Update: Fixed issue granting achievements upon game launch.
